module_summary: Asynchronous dual-clock FIFO: binary write/read pointers address a memory, Gray-coded copies cross clock domains via NFF synchronizers to form full and empty flags, with optional registered read.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO data array written in write domain, read in read domain

anchors.name: wr_addr
anchors.why: Binary write pointer addressing mem, advanced on accepted write

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Binary read pointer addressing mem, advanced on read

anchors.name: o_rd_data
anchors.why: Read data output, registered from mem when lcl_read

anchors.name: o_wr_full
anchors.why: Full flag comparing synced read Gray pointer; blocks writes

anchors.name: o_rd_empty
anchors.why: Empty flag registered from lcl_rd_empty for read side

anchors.name: i_wr
anchors.why: Write request advancing pointer and writing mem when not full

anchors.name: i_rd
anchors.why: Read request consuming FIFO entry via lcl_read

anchors.name: wr_rgray
anchors.why: Read Gray pointer synchronized into write domain for full check

anchors.name: rd_wgray
anchors.why: Write Gray pointer synchronized into read domain for empty check

anchors.name: wgray
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer sent across clock domain

anchors.name: rgray
anchors.why: Gray-coded read pointer sent across clock domain

anchors.name: rgray_cross
anchors.why: Synchronizer flops for read Gray pointer into write clock

anchors.name: wgray_cross
anchors.why: Synchronizer flops for write Gray pointer into read clock

anchors.name: lcl_rd_empty
anchors.why: Unregistered empty compare gating read pointer advance

anchors.name: lcl_read
anchors.why: Read enable loading o_rd_data/o_rd_empty and advancing rd_addr

anchors.name: lcl_rd_data
anchors.why: Asynchronous memory read word before output register

groups.name: FIFO memory
groups.description: Dual-clock storage array with async read

groups.name: Write domain pointer logic
groups.description: Write pointer, Gray encoding and full flag generation

groups.name: Read domain pointer logic
groups.description: Read pointer, Gray encoding, empty flag and registered read output

groups.name: Clock domain crossing
groups.description: Multi-flop synchronizers carrying Gray pointers between clocks
